market_pulse.note: Closed down 561.25 points, or 1.11%, at 50,198.17 on Wednesday, its second straight sizable drop, as health insurers fell on a proposed Medicare anti-fraud rule (Yahoo Finance; Stock Titan).
Closed down 16.90 points, or 0.23%, at 7,323.63, its fifth straight losing session (Yahoo Finance; Stock Titan).
Closed up 101.50 points, or 0.42%, at 24,429.89, the only major index to finish higher despite Nvidia's decline (Yahoo Finance; Stock Titan).

December futures settled near $82.08, down $2.57 or 3.04%, after touching their lowest level since Aug. 31; EIA data showed a 3.4 million-barrel U.S. crude build (Yahoo Finance; CoinDesk; Discovery Alert).

themes.title: Nvidia falls after results
themes.summary: Nvidia closed down about 2.7% to 2.9% despite third-quarter revenue up 103% from a year earlier, as leadership changes under interim CEO Colette Kress kept investors cautious (Yahoo Finance; Stock Titan; CoinDesk).

themes.title: Health insurers drag the Dow
themes.summary: UnitedHealth and Humana fell for a second day after CMS proposed a Medicare Advantage anti-fraud rule; Cigna and CVS also declined (Yahoo Finance; Stock Titan).

themes.title: Fed minutes lean toward hikes
themes.summary: Minutes from the Oct. 27-28 meeting showed almost all officials saw further rate increases as likely appropriate, with two voters preferring a quarter-point hike at that meeting (Stock Titan; CoinDesk).

themes.title: Retailers rise on earnings
themes.summary: TJX gained about 8% and Target about 4% after quarterly results; Target reported EPS of $2.65 on $27.1 billion in sales, with tariff refunds contributing (Stock Titan; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Commodities and housing weaken
themes.summary: Gold fell about 3.5% to its lowest in over a year, and pending home sales dropped to their lowest level since at least 2001, down nearly 17% from a year earlier (Yahoo Finance; Stock Titan).

sectors.name: Semiconductors
sectors.note: Mixed: early gains faded as Nvidia fell, while AMD, Broadcom and TSMC posted modest gains (Yahoo Finance; Stock Titan).

sectors.name: Health Care
sectors.note: The weakest group, led lower by UnitedHealth and Humana; Ardent Health fell about 19% on a secondary share sale (Stock Titan; Yahoo Finance).

sectors.name: Consumer Discretionary / Retail
sectors.note: Relative strength as TJX and Target rose after earnings; Lowe's also beat estimates (Stock Titan; Yahoo Finance).

sectors.name: Energy
sectors.note: Among the weakest S&P 500 sectors, down nearly 3% at midday as oil slid; Exxon fell about 3.6% (Stock Titan; Yahoo Finance).

watch_list.why: Bloomberg reported the upsized IPO priced at $83 a share, above the expected $70-$78 range; shares are slated to begin trading Thursday under the ticker ANT (Yahoo Finance; CoinDesk).

watch_list.topic: Palo Alto reaction and Medicare rule
watch_list.why: Palo Alto Networks rose about 6.5% after hours on revenue up 39% to $3.44 billion; the CMS Medicare Advantage rule is scheduled to appear in the Federal Register Thursday (Stock Titan).
CME FedWatch has shown about a 96% chance of a December rate increase, and Governor Waller has said a half-point move is probably needed (CoinDesk; Stock Titan).
